headline: LITEON Reports Q3 Sales of NT$57.4 Billion, Up 28% Year-on-Year
summary: LITEON Technology reported third-quarter consolidated sales of NT$57.4 billion, up 9% quarter-on-quarter and 28% year-on-year. Nine-month earnings per share rose 64% to NT$8.08.
why: LITEON Technology is a Taiwan-based manufacturer of optoelectronics and power supply solutions for global electronics and technology hardware sectors.

impacts.name: LITEON Technology
impacts.why: Strong Q3 revenue growth and record nine-month EPS reflect robust operational performance.
